query: What closed-form variational updates or unbiased reparameterized gradient estimators apply to q(f_h) and q(g) under sparse inducing-point GPs, and to q(z) under Gumbel-Softmax including temperature schedules and bias correction?

response.query: What closed-form variational updates or unbiased reparameterized gradient estimators apply to q(f_h) and q(g) under sparse inducing-point GPs, and to q(z) under Gumbel-Softmax including temperature schedules and bias correction?
response.answer: Closed-form variational updates for sparse inducing-point GPs use reparameterized gradient estimators for q(f_h) and q(g). For q(z) in Gumbel-Softmax, unbiased estimators with temperature schedules and bias correction are applied.
